title: Template visible workflow task registry
summary: Copy this registry when a workflow should become a visible Mathformer task object.

visible_workflows.description: A user-visible workflow composed of controlled actions and skills.

composed_skills.role: Route the visible workflow through the controlled hub before lower-level scripts run.

risk_controls.control: The task registry validator checks required fields and hub references.
